description.zh-CN: MCU/embedded 开发 preset（embedded team 现成）。arm64 容器注意 ripgrep 自动降级（见 arch_note）。
description.en-US: MCU/embedded preset (embedded team, existing). arm64 containers: note the automatic ripgrep downgrade (see arch_note).

note.zh-CN: embedded team（现成）；MCU 场景 = 第①层（工具链共享卷）；Pi 弱端验证环境
note.en-US: embedded team (existing); MCU scenario = layer ① (shared-volume toolchain); Pi as weak-end verification env

arch_note.zh-CN: arm64 16K 页系统（如 Pi）：qwen-code 0.25.0 的 bundled ripgrep 崩溃后自动优雅降级 built-in grep，无需配置字段（10/8 Pi 实测；上游 issue 稿已备）。若未来需手动钉死内置搜索，正确字段是 tools.useRipgrep:false（= built-in grep）——不是 tools.useBuiltinRipgrep（那只切 bundled rg → 系统级 rg，且仅 useRipgrep=true 时生效）。
arch_note.en-US: arm64 16K-page systems (e.g. Pi): qwen-code 0.25.0's bundled ripgrep crash auto-downgrades gracefully to built-in grep — no config field required (verified on Pi 10/08; upstream issue draft ready). If a manual pin to built-in search is ever needed, the correct field is tools.useRipgrep:false (= built-in grep) — NOT tools.useBuiltinRipgrep (which only switches bundled rg → system-level rg, and only when useRipgrep=true).

install.zh-CN: arm-none-eabi-gcc / ESP-IDF / Zephyr 按 MCU 平台 → 共享卷
install.en-US: arm-none-eabi-gcc / ESP-IDF / Zephyr per MCU platform → shared volume

note.zh-CN: 工具链动 CR（env）= 团队级决策，preset 只生成建议清单
note.en-US: Toolchain changes touch the CR (env) = team-level decision; preset only generates the suggestion list
